A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same AudioX study and contain complete main text, references, and appendices. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original AudioX benchmark results in Tables 1–4, a user study in Figure 4, and ablations in Figures 5–6 and Appendix Table A3.

after.justification: v2 retains the original benchmark evaluations, user-study outcomes, and ablation results in the main text and appendix.

M1.justification: Section 4 and Figure 3 retain identical modality encoders, projections, input masking, diffusion Transformer, and training objective. No algorithmic component or procedure changes.

E1.justification: Sections 3 and 5 and Table A1 retain identical training and evaluation coverage, including audio/music generation, image-to-audio generation, audio inpainting, music completion, and AVVP out-of-domain testing.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within all quantitative and qualitative comparisons. Tables 1, 2, and 4 retain the same baselines, including AudioLDM variants, MMAudio, FoleyCrafter, and Seeing&Hearing in their respective experiments.

E3.justification: The dataset splits and sample counts in Table A1, training and inference settings in Section 5.1, and metrics in Section 5.2 are unchanged. Both versions use 10 users and 25 samples per task for the user study.

E4.justification: Both versions contain identical mask-ratio, masking-strategy, and modality-combination ablations in Figures 5–6 and Table A3. The out-of-domain evaluation and qualitative examples in Figures A1–A2 are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point estimates and averaged user-study scores. Neither adds repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted findings, and qualitative examples match, including the appendices. For example, AudioX's AudioCaps text-to-audio results remain IS 12.09, FD 11.83, and FAD 1.86 in Table 1.

T1.justification: Equations 1–4 and their accompanying mathematical formulation are identical. No definitions, assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: unified audio/music generation, multimodal input masking, curated caption datasets, and strong performance across generation tasks.

C2.justification: The interpretations of multimodal integration, AVVP generalization, video redundancy, and information leakage under feature masking are unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added.

D1.justification: Encoder choices, parameter counts, hyperparameters, hardware, GPU hours, and inference settings in Section 5.1 are identical. Caption-generation details and statements promising future code and dataset release also remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the reference list are identical. No cited works or substantive positioning relative to prior research change.

P1.justification: Page 1 changes Xu Tan's affiliation from 'Moonshot AI' to 'Independent Researcher' and updates the arXiv stamp from v1 dated 13 March 2025 to v2 dated 23 April 2025. All other wording and document structure match.

P2.justification: Figures 1–6 and A1–A2, Tables 1–4 and A1–A3, their captions, and their placement are unchanged. Rendered pages show no figure, table, or layout revision.

improvement.justification: The only differences are the affiliation and arXiv version/date text on page 1. Methods, evidence, interpretations, reproducibility information, and appendices are identical, leaving overall paper quality meaningfully unchanged.
